summary: Jurisdiction of DERC under Electricity Act, 2003 s.63 and s.86(1)(b); applicability to municipal bodies for WTE project bidding; statutory duty of MCD under SWM Rules, 2016; competitive bidding for waste-to-energy project upheld; APTEL's jurisdictional challenge rejected; public interest in municipal waste management emphasized; DERC's authority to approve tariff and PPA affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Energy Watchdog v. Central Electricity Regulatory Commission and others
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned APTEL judgment set aside; DERC orders upholding tariff and bidding process restored.
